g.text: 1x100+2x4.7+3x0.47uF; VCCBRAM 1x47+1x0.47uF; bulk placement p24) https://docs.amd.com/v/u/en-US/ug483_7Series_PCB. The fitted total still exceeds the MPS limit: loop phase margin, load step, DC bias and PDN are unverified; fit C89 only after bench Bode/load-step data. V49 (Howard 13 Nov 2026, Claude): C4 set DNP (footprint kept). Reason 1: C4 is up to 1.45 mm tall in the 1.5 mm gap to the FPGA-LDO board (design review V3 SYS-08, FE-04). Reason 2: VCCINT_1V0 falls from 186.39 to 86.39 uF nominal, under the MPS 100 uF maximum (FE-01). UG483 Table 2-2 asks for 1 x 100 uF VCCINT bulk: no longer met; load step and ripple unverified, measure on the first board. V49 also: U1 grade XC7A35T-2CSG325I -> XC7A35T-2CSG325C (JLC C1521720, the chips already in the JLC parts inventory; Howard 13 Nov 2026). Same package, pinout and speed grade; commercial junction range 0 to 85 C instead of -40 to 100 C (AMD DS181, https://docs.amd.com/v/u/en-US/ds181_Artix_7_Data_Sheet). Junction temperature in the head stack is unmeasured: read XADC at bring-up.

Reason 2: VCCINT_1V0 falls from 186.39 to 86.39 uF nominal, under the MPS 100 uF maximum (FE-01). Same package, pinout and speed grade; commercial junction range 0 to 85 C instead of -40 to 100 C (AMD DS181, https://docs.amd.com/v/u/en-US/ds181_Artix_7_Data_Sheet). g.text: 2. Source / changes: Trenz TE0714-04-42I-7-L REV04 p6:125MHz LVDS U2, L1 ferrite, C10=470nF, R1=100R and C134/C135=100nF coupling. https://www.trenz-electronic.de/trenzdownloads/Trenz_Electronic/Modules_and_Module_Carriers/3x4/TE0714/REV04/Documents/SCH-TE0714-04-42I-7-L.PDF Adapted by Codex: Y1=AX3DAF1-125.0000T3 (exact Trenz oscillator MPN undisclosed), C80=470nF, C81 10uF->100nF; added L4. External R56 removed per UG482 Fig. 5-8 p226 (100nF caps only); with it, AX3 swing is 250-450mV against DS181 350mV minimum. Unverified: on ports 1, 2, 7 and 8 12/14 are open at the XEM (ESD only), so D8/C8 float with no failsafe bias and firmware must use the folded SYNC there; D8/C8 are in bank 15, not the cable clock bank 14, so capture uses a global clock; port-number strap or firmware selection not defined.

IBERT.

g.text: 1. Function: U1 / J1 / J2: Route 121 FPGA lines (120 signals for eight 1.5 V ASICs and one spare, J1.36) through two 70-contact Hirose DF40C-70DS mezzanines with 15 grounds (J1 14/15/27/30/34/41/50/66, J2 14/15/27/34/41/50/66). J2.68-70 carry VIN_3V3 and J1.32 carries VIN_5V (unused provision, 0.3 A, between grounds J1.30 and J1.34) to the FPGA-LDO board. Contact order follows pin map V6: top chips ASIC3/4/7/8 have their own SPI data, clock and latch; each returned 32 MHz clock is on a P-side MRCC/SRCC ball.
